title: Central POST /api/sessions validates a remote project's workdir as a local directory and returns 400 before remote routing
outcome: Creating a session in a remote-backed project through Central's POST /api/sessions with an explicit workdir that exists only on the remote host should route to the remote, or give a clear error that names the cause. It should not fail local directory validation with a 400. Observed 2026-11-07 ~23:06Z by Questly::Codex2: creating a Mac Questly session (remote macbookpro, root /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/questly) with workdir returned 400 from local validation, while the same call with projectId only (inheriting the project's remote root) succeeded (session-16749).
acceptance: For a remote-backed project, POST /api/sessions with a workdir inside that project's remote root is validated against the remote, not the local filesystem. It either succeeds or returns an error naming the actual remote-side cause. A workdir outside the project's root is still refused.

A deterministic test covers a remote-backed project with a remote-only workdir (success or a named remote error), and a workdir outside the root (refused), using the existing remote test seams; it uses no live remote.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed input.

completion.summary: Landed remote-project workdir routing in bf7ff309: remote-only explicit paths reach the owning host; deterministic focused10 and reviewed source plus exact-tree Linux/Windows FULL evidence recorded.
